newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Parapine Timber buys into UK systems firm.
newsitem.headline: Parapine Timber buys into UK systems firm.

text.p: Timber retailer Parapine Timber NZ Ltd said on Wednesday it had acquired 20 percent of a British internet services company.
The unidentified company develops a system of Internet gaming products.
Parapine will issue 88 million shares in Parapine and 100 million July 2002 options exercisable at 10 cents in consideration for the purchase.
The agreement is subject to Parapine carrying out due diligence on the project by June 16 and will also be subject to shareholder approval.

The deal was not a related-party transaction, Parapine said. If the agreement becomes unconditional Parapine will also have the option of acquiring the other 80 percent of the company for a further issue of shares.
